name: rg-build
command: bash scripts/build-render-graph.sh

name: rg-wiring-check
command: node web/common/render-graph-job.mjs check --page dist/render-graph --out out/render-graph/wiring --stage wiring

name: rg-wiring-select
command: node web/common/render-graph-job.mjs select --page dist/render-graph --out out/render-graph/wiring --stage wiring

name: rg-wiring-clean
command: node web/common/render-graph-job.mjs clean --page dist/render-graph --out out/render-graph/wiring --stage wiring

name: rg-wiring-render
command: node web/common/render-graph-job.mjs render --page dist/render-graph --out out/render-graph/wiring --stage wiring

name: rg-wiring-fresh
command: node web/common/render-graph-job.mjs fresh --page dist/render-graph --out out/render-graph/wiring --stage wiring

name: rg-wiring-judge-local
command: node --test examples/render-graph/parameters.test.mjs examples/render-graph/views.test.mjs examples/render-graph/wiring.test.mjs

name: rg-wiring-judge
command: node web/common/render-graph-job.mjs judge --page dist/render-graph --out out/render-graph/wiring --stage wiring --budget-s 1020
